sources.role: user-directory/config paths, input configuration, savedata, system modules and save-state feature boundary
official save-data and Qt/SDL configuration documentation

paths.path: shadPS4 user directory (default ~/.local/share/shadps4/user/config.toml; portable user directory may be selected in Settings > Paths)
paths.naming: TOML config.toml with sections/keys generated by the Qt/SDL configuration layer; exact key names are source-defined and not a separate controller profile format

paths.path: Input section of user/config.toml and Qt Configure > Input UI
paths.naming: Bindings are source-defined physical-key/button entries; the upstream input implementation accepts up to three keys per binding plus mouse buttons/motion mapped to joystick input; no separate input file
evidence: source:shadPS4 input implementation supports three keys/mouse/joystick

paths.path: No console BIOS file is required; optional PS4 system-module files are under user/sys_modules when a title requires them
paths.naming: System modules retain their source filenames under sys_modules; the cited shadPS4 sources publish no canonical firmware checksum

paths.path: No cryptographic firmware-key file is required by the shadPS4 runtime contract
paths.naming: No key filename or canonical checksum is published by the cited source

paths.path: user/savedata/1/<Game ID>/ under the configured user directory
paths.naming: Per-game directories keyed by PS4 Game ID, containing the files written by the title (including param.sfo where present)

paths.path: No documented emulator save-state output in the cited shadPS4 desktop source/docs
paths.naming: Unsupported/unresolved; do not classify title savedata under user/savedata as emulator states
